bug.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell us what happened and how we can reproduce the issue.

feedback.intro: Your opinion helps us build an increasingly better app.

changeProfile.title: How do I change my profile details?
changeProfile.content: Open Profile, tap the settings icon and choose Edit profile. Update the details you want and save your changes.

resetPassword.title: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.content: On the login screen, use the password recovery option. Instructions will be sent to your registered email.

manageSubscription.title: How do I manage my subscription?
manageSubscription.content: Subscriptions are managed by the store used for purchase. Open App Store or Google Play subscription settings to view or cancel it.

assessmentEstimate.title: Is body fat percentage a diagnosis?
assessmentEstimate.content: No. The assessment result is an estimate for tracking progress and does not replace an assessment or diagnosis by a health professional.

changeWorkout.title: Can I replace an exercise?
changeWorkout.content: When alternatives are available, use the replace option in the exercise. The options preserve the muscle group and workout purpose.

changeLanguage.title: How do I change the app language?
changeLanguage.content: Open Profile, Settings, then Language. Choose Português, English or Español; the change is applied immediately.

appNotLoading.title: The app won't load. What should I do?
appNotLoading.content: Check your connection, close and reopen the app, and check for an available update. If it continues, open a ticket and describe when it happens.

contactSupport.title: How do I contact support?
contactSupport.content: At the end of any article, say it did not solve your issue and tap Open ticket. You can also use Report a problem in Settings.
